meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上并配置 BGPT MCP 服务器后，Claude 会调用它的 search_papers 工具搜索科学论文，返回从全文提取的结构化数据：方法、结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等，每篇 25+ 个字段。
howto.when: 当你要找带具体实验细节的论文、做系统性或范围性文献综述，或需要摘要里没有的定量结果、样本量时触发；使用前需先在 MCP 设置里配置 BGPT 服务器。
howto.what_en: Once the BGPT MCP server is configured, Claude calls its search_papers tool to find scientific papers and returns structured data extracted from full texts: methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions, 25+ fields per paper.
howto.when_en: Use when you need papers with specific experimental details, systematic or scoping literature reviews, or quantitative results and sample sizes not in abstracts. The BGPT MCP server must be configured first.
